extras: Writing Mode only changes how the note is displayed; the Markdown file is modified only when One-click Formatting is explicitly run. README says to install from the community plugins directory 'when it becomes available,' suggesting it was not yet released.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in typography, paper-layout, or Chinese-specific text-formatting controls for long-form writing.
summary: Writing layout plugin for long-form Chinese text that adds typography, paper themes, formatting, and export while leaving Markdown unchanged.
